explanation: A portaled menu is positioned once when it opens, so closeMenuOnScroll closes it as soon as anything scrolls. With menuPosition 'absolute' react-select scrolls the page itself to make room for a menu that does not fit below the fold; that scroll event closes the menu a few milliseconds after it opened. The test was also fragile: it clicked a snapshot with force, its menu selector also matched layout icons, and it asserted nothing.
fix: Render the select menu with menuPosition 'fixed' so react-select does not scroll the page, and rewrite the test to click the control through a data-cy hook, pick the option by text inside .react-select__menu with scrollBehavior: false, and assert the house is selected.
